briefing.on_open: Good evening. It's 4:47 p.m. Eastern. Polls are still open everywhere. No race has been officially decided. 35 Senate seats, 36 governorships and 435 House seats are on the board. Overall data confidence is 0 out of 100. What would you like to look at?
briefing.delta: Nothing official has changed since your last look at 4:19 p.m. Eastern.

feed.notes: Fetched 2026-11-03: results index lists 2026 Primary (id=26prim) but no general-election entry yet. Primary pattern observed: per-house-district PDFs at /enr26/results/HD<n>.pdf and statewide precinct CSV at /enr26/results/GA_ENR_Precinct_State_of_Alaska.csv (verified for the Aug 18 primary). Expect the general to appear on the same index page; re-check on election night.

Fetched 2026-11-03: 'Unofficial Election Night Results — Results Coming Soon, polls close 7:00 pm CST'. Statewide and County Results views (chooseCounty.aspx?ecode=1001305). 'Export Data' is an ASP.NET postback (hlnkExportData), not a stable file URL. No JSON/CSV endpoint found.

Fetched 2026-11-03: sos.arkansas.gov election-results page links the 2026 General Election & Judicial Runoff to the new Tally ENR site (vendor transition; SOS notes downloads temporarily unavailable, contact electionsemail@sos.arkansas.gov for data). Site is a JS SPA (/assets/index-1.10.20-*.js); no public JSON endpoint identified. No longer on Clarity (results.enr.clarityelections.com/AR returns 403).

UNVERIFIED FETCH: results.arizona.vote returned Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) to both fetchers; URL comes from azsos.gov search results (official). azsos.gov 2026 election info page also 403'd. County-level results are the norm on this platform; no machine-readable endpoint confirmed.

api.sos.ca.gov/returns/* verified live 2026-11-03 (JSON; currently serving the last election's data until polls close). Patterns verified: /returns/status (per-county precincts reporting), /returns/<office>/county/<county> (e.g. /returns/secretary-of-state/county/fresno). electionresults.sos.ca.gov currently 302s to sos.ca.gov/elections/prior-elections until election night (Incapsula-protected).

Scytl/Clarity. Verified 2026-11-03: current_ver.txt -> 383402; summary JSON at https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO/127407/<ver>/json/en/summary.json (shows 2026 US Senate: Hickenlooper/Baisley etc.); electionsettings.json also present (gzip). County JSON: /CO/127407/<ver>/json/en/<countyJsonFile> per electionsettings. SOS also posts unaggregated county results at https://www.coloradosos.gov/pubs/elections/Results/ENR/countyLevelResults.html.

UNVERIFIED FETCH: electionresults.ct.gov refused (robots_disallowed / proxy CONNECT 502). This is the SOTS Election Night Reporting system (town-level, as used in 2024). portal.ct.gov election-results page lists only archives. Town (not county) is the reporting unit; map towns to counties.

_meta.timezone_note: close_et is U.S. Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5). Values 00:00/01:00 fall on Nov 4 ET. close_utc is unambiguous.

AK.notes: 8 p.m. local. Mainland Alaska (AKST) = 00:00 ET Nov 4; Aleutian precincts on Hawaii-Aleutian time = 01:00 ET Nov 4 (last close).

AL.notes: 7 p.m. CT statewide (20:00 ET); the few Eastern-time localities close 7 p.m. ET (19:00 ET).

AZ.notes: 7 p.m. MST (Arizona does not observe DST) = 21:00 ET.

CA.notes: 8 p.m. PT. Largely vote-by-mail; ballots postmarked by election day count if received within 7 days.

FL.notes: 7 p.m. local: peninsula (ET) closes 19:00 ET; panhandle (CT) closes 20:00 ET (last close). Statewide results are typically withheld until 20:00 ET.

HI.notes: 7 p.m. HST = 00:00 ET Nov 4. Largely vote-by-mail.

ID.notes: 8 p.m. local: southern Idaho (MT) = 22:00 ET; northern panhandle (PT) = 23:00 ET (last close).

IN.notes: 6 p.m. local: most of state (ET) = 18:00 ET; northwest/southwest counties (CT) = 19:00 ET (last close).

KS.notes: 7 p.m. local: most of state (CT) = 20:00 ET; four western counties (MT) = 21:00 ET (last close). Counties may stay open until 8 p.m. CT.

KY.notes: 6 p.m. local: eastern Kentucky (ET) = 18:00 ET; western Kentucky (CT) = 19:00 ET (last close).

ME.notes: 8 p.m. ET. Ranked-choice voting used for federal general elections.

MI.notes: 8 p.m. local: Lower Peninsula and most of Upper Peninsula (ET) = 20:00 ET; four western UP counties (CT) = 21:00 ET (last close).

ND.notes: Counties set hours; polls close between 7 and 9 p.m. local. Most close 7 p.m. local (20:00 ET Central / 21:00 ET Mountain). Statutory latest possible close is 9 p.m. MT (23:00 ET).

NE.notes: 8 p.m. CT / 7 p.m. MT = 21:00 ET statewide.

NH.notes: Set by municipality; no earlier than 7 p.m. ET. Most towns close 7 p.m.; largest cities 8 p.m. (last close 20:00 ET).

OR.notes: 8 p.m. local: most of state (PT) = 23:00 ET; Malheur County (MT) = 22:00 ET. All-mail state.

SD.notes: 7 p.m. local: eastern SD (CT) = 20:00 ET; western SD (MT) = 21:00 ET (last close).

TN.notes: 8 p.m. ET in East Tennessee / 7 p.m. CT in Middle and West Tennessee = 20:00 ET statewide.

TX.notes: 7 p.m. local: most of state (CT) = 20:00 ET; El Paso and Hudspeth counties (MT) = 21:00 ET (last close).
